_about: Swearings-in not tied to an election in elections.json: every US presidential oath (inaugurations and successions) and the Indian prime ministers' oaths with no general election before them. A time is given only where a source states it (oath_time_source quotes it); an inauguration whose minute is not recorded is cast at noon (approx), the hour the ceremony was held. Before standard time (18 Nov 1883) tz_east is the place's local mean time.
